assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope, raising concern for intermittent arrhythmia.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptoms with potential cardiac rhythm disturbances.
The procedure was medically necessary to evaluate the patient's clinical presentation and reduce the risk of adverse neurological events.
